notes: Creative blueprint. Each shot starts at phrase `from` of its block (s00 is the title before narration). Durations come from the narration timeline (timeline.json). transition_in: cut | dissolve | flash (white) | fade_black.

shots.title: Golgotha - title
shots.visual: Wide cinematic shot of three wooden crosses on the rocky, skull-faced hill of Golgotha outside Jerusalem's walls. Vast dramatic sky at the sixth hour: bright golden sun partly veiled by towering clouds, crepuscular rays fanning down, a dark storm front creeping in from one side. Dust drifting. Camera slow push-in and gentle rise. MUST BE BRIGHT AND READABLE FROM FRAME 1 (this frame is the social-media thumbnail): the central cross centered in the middle square of the portrait frame, warm golden light, no fade from black. Leave the upper-middle area calm for the title text overlay.

shots.title: Face on the cross
shots.visual: Close-up of Jesus on the cross: crown of thorns, long dark hair, beard, sweat and dust, a little blood at the brow (tasteful). He lifts his eyes to the sky as the light dims (the sun is darkening). Slow push-in. Backlit rim light from the dimming sun, cool fill.

shots.title: So far
shots.visual: The camera pulls away from the cross, rising and receding until the cross is a tiny speck on the hill beneath a vast sky that turns dark at midday; the sun dims to a dull red disk behind clouds. Emphasize distance and loneliness.

shots.title: Day and night timelapse
shots.visual: Time-lapse over the Judean hills: the sun races across the sky, shadows of rocks and a lone dead tree sweep across the ground, clouds streak, the sky turns from day to blazing dusk to night with stars emerging.

shots.title: Gethsemane prayer
shots.visual: Flashback: the garden of Gethsemane at night. Jesus (in a simple robe) kneels at a large rock among gnarled olive trees, praying with head bowed and hands clasped on the rock. Cold blue moonlight through the branches, drifting mist, a few fireflies of dust in the light. Slow lateral dolly.

shots.title: Enthroned - Holy of Holies
shots.visual: Inside the temple's Holy of Holies: the camera glides through a parting embroidered curtain toward the golden Ark of the Covenant, two golden cherubim on its lid with wings arched toward each other; between them an intense radiant light (the glory) pours out, incense smoke curling through light shafts. End rising into the blinding light.

shots.title: Red Sea crossing
shots.visual: Flashback: the Red Sea parted at dawn. Towering walls of churning blue-green water rise on both sides, spray blowing off their tops; a multitude of Israelites (robed figures with staffs, bundles, some with children and animals) walk across the wet seabed toward the light. Camera low behind them, slowly following.

shots.title: Moses with staff
shots.visual: Moses stands on a rock at the far shore, staff raised high, silhouetted against the sunrise, as the people stream past below and reach safety; behind them the walls of water crash together in spray.

shots.title: The worm
shots.visual: Macro ground-level shot in the dust at the foot of the cross: a small crimson worm crawls across cracked earth and pebbles. Sandaled feet of passers-by stride past kicking up dust. The camera tilts and rises up the rough wooden upright of the cross toward the crucified figure, silhouetted against the dim sky, while people turn away.

shots.title: Mocking crowd
shots.visual: High angle from the cross looking down at a crowd of onlookers and religious leaders in robes, prayer shawls and head coverings; they shake their heads, point and sneer up at the camera. Harsh dim light of the darkened sun, dust in the air.

shots.title: He trusts in the Lord
shots.visual: A chief priest in rich robes and turban gestures mockingly toward the sky, other leaders nod; Roman soldiers laugh behind. Above the cross the wooden placard 'Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews' is visible. Camera slowly orbits.

shots.title: Nativity
shots.visual: Flashback in warm golden light: a Bethlehem stable cave at night, straw and a wooden manger, an oil lamp glowing; young Mary cradles the newborn wrapped in swaddling cloths against her, gazing down tenderly; an ox and a donkey rest nearby; silver starlight streams through the doorway.

shots.title: Mary at the cross
shots.visual: Match: Mary's face, now older, veiled in blue-grey, at the foot of the cross, looking up with tears; the dim cold light of the darkened afternoon; the wooden upright of the cross out of focus in the foreground. Slow push-in.

shots.title: Trouble is near
shots.visual: Flashback: Gethsemane at night. Torches of an armed mob advance through the twisted olive trees (trouble is near) while the disciples' silhouettes flee into the darkness; Jesus stands alone in the growing torchlight. Smoke and embers.

shots.title: Bulls of Bashan
shots.visual: Symbolic nightmare: in a red-brown dust storm, massive dark bulls circle the cross on the hill. Camera near ground level slowly rotating as hooves pound and dust bursts; horns silhouetted against a dim red sun.

shots.title: Roaring lions
shots.visual: Out of the darkness and dust, lions emerge with glinting eyes; one lion advances and roars straight at the camera, mouth wide. Dramatic rim light, dust.

shots.title: Poured out like water
shots.visual: Slow motion: water poured from a tilted earthen clay jar splashes onto cracked parched ground and drains away into the cracks. Then the strained arms stretched along the crossbeam (bones out of joint).

shots.title: Heart of wax
shots.visual: In darkness, a single beeswax candle melts down in time-lapse, the flame guttering, wax running down its sides and pooling into a spreading puddle.

shots.title: Potsherd
shots.visual: Harsh white sun: a broken clay potsherd lies on dry, cracked earth; heat haze shimmers; cracks spread across the clay and the ground; a dry thorn branch nearby.

shots.title: Dust of death
shots.visual: A hand opens and fine dust pours from it, carried away by the wind across the ground; behind, the skull-like rock face of Golgotha in fading light.

shots.title: Dogs surround
shots.visual: Dusk: a pack of wild dogs prowls in a circle around the camera, eyes glinting; behind them the legs and sandals of Roman soldiers also circle. Low, menacing, handheld feel.

shots.title: They pierce
shots.visual: Close: an iron spike held against rough wood; a hammer is raised high against the darkened sky - cut at the moment of impact to a single drop of blood running along the wood grain. Tasteful, no gore.

shots.title: They stare
shots.visual: From behind the crowd: heads and shoulders of onlookers silhouetted in the foreground, staring up at the crucified figure on the cross in the dim eclipse light; one gloats, arms crossed.

shots.title: Casting lots
shots.visual: Roman soldiers kneel around a cloth on the rocky ground at the foot of the cross; bone dice tumble in slow motion across the folded seamless tunic; a hand snatches the garment.

shots.title: Light breaks
shots.visual: The turn: in the darkness a single shaft of light breaks through the clouds and falls on the cross; more rays follow; the camera rises toward the light.

shots.title: Sword falls
shots.visual: A Roman sword lies in the dust catching the new light; a soldier's hand lets go of it; the dogs scatter into the darkness as the light spreads across the ground.

shots.title: Beasts to dust
shots.visual: Silhouettes of a lion and a great wild ox made of dark ash disintegrate into particles that blow away as the advancing golden light touches them.

shots.title: Empty tomb
shots.visual: Resurrection morning: the great round stone rolls aside from a rock-cut tomb, dawn light floods in; inside, the folded linen grave cloths lie on the stone bench; the tomb is empty. Camera moves in.

shots.title: Praise him
shots.visual: A multitude on a hillside at sunrise raise their hands in praise, robes and scarves moving in the wind; the camera cranes up over them toward the sun.

shots.title: Scarred hand
shots.visual: Close: the open, nail-scarred hand of the risen Christ in warm sunlight; the healed wound visible in the palm; dust motes glitter.

shots.title: His face in the light
shots.visual: The sun emerges fully from the clouds and warm light washes over the face of the risen Jesus, peaceful, eyes opening and lifting (bookend of the opening close-up), no crown of thorns.

shots.title: Great assembly
shots.visual: A great assembly gathered in a stone courtyard at dusk, hundreds of oil lamps glowing, people standing and singing, faces lit warmly; camera glides over them.

shots.title: Bread broken
shots.visual: Close: hands break a round loaf of flatbread at a rough wooden table in warm lamplight, steam rising; many hands reach in and receive pieces; a clay cup of wine.

shots.title: Ends of the earth
shots.visual: Earth seen from space: the sunrise terminator sweeps across the globe, the atmosphere glowing, light spreading over the continents (Middle East/Africa/Europe first).

shots.title: Nations bow
shots.visual: People of many nations, diverse in skin tone and dress, kneel on a vast plain at dawn facing a distant hill where an empty cross is lit by the rising sun. Camera slowly rises behind them.

shots.title: Crowns laid down
shots.visual: Golden crowns and jeweled goblets are laid down on the rocky ground at the foot of the empty cross by hands in rich embroidered sleeves; morning sun glints on the gold.

shots.title: Kneeling in the dust
shots.visual: An old man in a worn robe slowly kneels down in the dust and bows, dust motes floating in a shaft of sunlight.

shots.title: Told to the next generation
shots.visual: Night, by a small fire: a grandfather holds an open scroll and tells a young child the story; he passes a lit clay oil lamp into the child's hands. Warm firelight, sparks rising.

shots.title: River of lights
shots.visual: The flame is passed on: a long line of people stretching into the distance across dark hills, each holding a lit oil lamp, forming a winding river of lights under the pre-dawn sky.

shots.title: He has done it
shots.visual: Final: the empty cross on Golgotha at glorious sunrise, a white linen cloth draped over the crossbeam moving in the breeze, golden rays bursting through clouds, the camera rises past the cross into the light. Bright, triumphant. Continues through the outro (end title).
